evals.prompt: Turn evals/files/sample.md into a nicely typeset A4 PDF.
evals.expected_output: sample.pdf built with build_pdf.py; check_pdf.py exits 0.
expectations: check_pdf.py reports no FAIL
Body font is Charis SIL (or a user-named professional font), never Times/Arial/DejaVu
Body size 11 pt, leading 120–145 %, measure 73–77 chars
Straight quotes, -- and ... in the source appear as curly quotes, en dash and ellipsis
Numeric table columns are right-aligned; the 10-column inspection log spans into the margins, the 4-column table does not
Inline and display formulas are rendered, with no raw LaTeX in the text
The 3-node chain diagram is horizontal; the branching diagram is vertical with orthogonal edges
Page images were inspected before delivery

evals.prompt: Write a one-page letter in Spanish to a client confirming the handover date of their flat is 15 December, and give me it as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Markdown source in Spanish plus a PDF built with --lang es.
expectations: build_pdf.py called with --lang es
Double quotes rendered as « »
Fits on one page; no page number on page 1
No bold and italic together; no underline; no all-caps lines
check_pdf.py reports no FAIL

evals.prompt: Make a US-letter PDF handout from these notes with first-line indents instead of paragraph spacing: <three paragraphs of plain text>.
expectations: build_pdf.py called with --paper letter and --indent
Paragraphs use indents and no extra space between them
check_pdf.py reports no FAIL

evals.prompt: Make a PDF explaining the Pythagorean theorem with the formula a^2 + b^2 = c^2 displayed, and a flowchart of: measure sides → square them → add → take square root.
evals.expected_output: PDF with a display formula and a horizontal 4-node flowchart.
expectations: Display formula rendered as SVG
Flowchart is a single chain of 4 nodes, so it renders horizontally (LR)
check_pdf.py reports no FAIL

evals.prompt: Turn evals/files/report.md into a formal report PDF with cover, table of contents and numbered sections.
evals.expected_output: report.pdf built with --doc report; check_pdf.py --report exits 0.
expectations: Page 1 is the cover with organisation, title, subtitle, author, date and version; no page number
Page 2 is the contents page numbered ii, listing ## and ### entries with correct page numbers
Body starts at page 1; headings numbered 1, 1.1, 1.1.1; running head shows the title
check_pdf.py --report: no FAIL (cover, toc, numbering pass)

evals.prompt: Hazme un informe en PDF sobre la inspección de la obra (escribe tú unos apartados de ejemplo), con portada a nombre de Isidro Rodríguez, versión 0.1.
evals.expected_output: Spanish report built with --doc report --lang es.
expectations: Front matter has author and version "0.1"
Contents title is 'Índice'; cover shows 'Versión 0.1'; quotes are « »
check_pdf.py --report: no FAIL
